name: Re-cut of the 5C spot to new music
note: The test: take the 15 shots our detector found in Apple's own advertisement and re-cut them to a different track, then compare against the edit Apple's own editors made from the same material. No subject selection -- the pool is 15 shots and all of them are wanted. INTERNAL ONLY: the footage is Apple's and the music is a commercial master.
not_official: Evaluation only. Nothing built from this may be published.
format_note: The source's own geometry, so nothing is cropped away and the comparison is like for like.
prefers_note: Bright, because the spot lives on white. The brightness floor of 0.45 also drops the black frames the detector found at either end of the source.

coherence.note: Off. Fifteen shots from one film are already one world.

callbacks_note: There is only one clip -- reuse is counted per MOMENT, so this cap has to be high enough to let all 15 shots be used, several times each.
